name: Raging Thunder Vita
author: MetalSyntax
description: Unofficial port of Raging Thunder (Polarbit, Android) to the PS Vita, running the original ARM game library through a native loader (TheFloW's so-loader + FalsoJNI) with rendering via vitaGL.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
